title: Database Foundation
description: Establish the global Kysely database layer with all table types and a single initial migration creating the complete schema.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL
types.ts defines a Database interface including organizations, users, projects, tasks, comments tables and every table includes tenant_id: string except organizations
Generated<> is used ONLY on id, created_at, updated_at columns
001_initial.ts creates organizations, users, projects, tasks, comments tables in a single migration with all constraints, foreign keys, checks, and indexes exactly as defined in the specification
users.role has CHECK constraint restricting values to 'Admin','ProjectManager','Member'
projects.status has CHECK constraint restricting values to 'Active','Archived'
tasks.status has CHECK constraint restricting values to 'ToDo','InProgress','Completed'
Foreign keys use ON DELETE CASCADE or SET NULL exactly as specified
Indexes created: idx_users_tenant_id, idx_projects_tenant_id, idx_tasks_tenant_id, idx_tasks_project_id, idx_comments_task_id, idx_comments_tenant_id
migrate.ts runs all pending migrations on application bootstrap
app.module.ts imports DatabaseModule

title: Authentication Module
description: Implement JWT-based authentication with register, login, refresh token, global guard, and role decorators.
acceptance_criteria: AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/register marked with @Public()
RegisterDto has email: @IsEmail(), password: @IsString() @MinLength(8), first_name: @IsString() @Length(1,100), last_name: @IsString() @Length(1,100) and does NOT include role

POST /api/auth/register creates a new organization and user with role hardcoded to 'Member', hashes password using bcrypt with 12 salt rounds, and returns { id, email, first_name, last_name, role, tenant_id }
Register endpoint throws ConflictException if email already exists
AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/login marked with @Public()
LoginDto has email: @IsEmail(), password: @IsString()
POST /api/auth/login returns { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, role, tenant_id } }
JWT payload contains { sub, email, role, tenant_id }
JwtStrategy validate() returns { id: payload.sub, email, role, tenant_id }
Global APP_GUARD uses JwtAuthGuard and RolesGuard
@Public() decorator bypasses JWT guard
@Roles() decorator restricts routes using exact role strings
Refresh endpoint POST /api/auth/refresh marked with @Public() returns new { access_token } when provided valid refresh_token
AuthController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
All queries filter by tenant_id where applicable
AuthModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Organizations Module
description: Allow creation of a new organization with its first Admin user and return an access token.
acceptance_criteria: OrganizationsController exposes POST /api/organizations marked with @Public()
CreateOrganizationDto has name: @IsString() @Length(1,255), email: @IsEmail(), password: @MinLength(8), first_name: @Length(1,100), last_name: @Length(1,100)
POST /api/organizations creates organization and first user with role 'Admin', hashes password with bcrypt(12)
Email must be globally unique or throw ConflictException
Response is { access_token, user: { id, email, role: 'Admin', tenant_id } }
JWT payload contains { sub, email, role, tenant_id }
OrganizationsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
OrganizationsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Users Module
description: Provide tenant-scoped user listing for Admins with pagination.
acceptance_criteria: UsersController exposes GET /api/users?page=1&limit=20
GET /api/users requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/users filters by tenant_id = req.user.tenant_id
Pagination implemented using page, limit, offset and limit capped at 100
Response returns { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
Each user object contains id, email, first_name, last_name, role
UsersController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
UsersModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Projects Module
description: Enable creation and listing of tenant-scoped projects with role-based access control.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectsController exposes POST /api/projects
POST /api/projects requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateProjectDto has name: @IsString() @Length(1,255), description: @IsOptional() @IsString() @MaxLength(1000)
POST /api/projects sets status to 'Active' by default and tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id
Response returns { id, name, description, status: 'Active', tenant_id }
ProjectsController exposes GET /api/projects?page=1&limit=20
GET /api/projects accessible to any authenticated user
GET /api/projects filters by tenant_id and returns paginated { data, meta }
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', tenantId)
ProjectsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
ProjectsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Tasks Module
description: Allow creation of tasks within tenant projects with strict tenant validation and pagination.
acceptance_criteria: TasksController exposes POST /api/projects/:projectId/tasks
POST /api/projects/:projectId/tasks requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateTaskDto has title: @IsString() @Length(1,255), description: @IsOptional() @IsString(), assigned_to: @IsOptional() @IsUUID(), status: @IsOptional() @IsIn(['ToDo','InProgress','Completed'])
If status not provided default to 'ToDo'
Project must exist and belong to req.user.tenant_id or throw NotFoundException
If assigned_to provided, user must belong to same tenant or throw BadRequestException
Inserted task includes tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id
Response returns { id, title, status, project_id, assigned_to }
All queries include tenant_id filter
TasksController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
TasksModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Comments Module
description: Enable authenticated users to add tenant-scoped comments to tasks.
acceptance_criteria: CommentsController exposes POST /api/tasks/:taskId/comments
POST /api/tasks/:taskId/comments accessible to any authenticated user
CreateCommentDto has content: @IsString() @Length(1,2000)
Task must exist and belong to req.user.tenant_id or throw NotFoundException
Inserted comment sets user_id = req.user.id and tenant_id = req.user.tenant_id
Response returns { id, content, task_id, user_id }
All queries include tenant_id filter
CommentsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
CommentsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provide aggregated tenant dashboard metrics and basic notification listing.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardController exposes GET /api/dashboard
GET /api/dashboard returns { totalProjects, totalTasks, tasksByStatus: { ToDo, InProgress, Completed } } filtered by tenant_id
NotificationsController exposes GET /api/notifications?page=1&limit=20
GET /api/notifications returns paginated empty array structure { data: [], meta } (placeholder implementation)
All queries include tenant_id filter
Controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
DashboardModule and NotificationsModule are added to app.module.ts imports

title: Audit Logs Module
description: Introduce tenant-scoped audit logging for key actions across the system.
acceptance_criteria: Add audit_logs table definition to types.ts with id, action, entity, entity_id, user_id, tenant_id, created_at
Modify 001_initial.ts to create audit_logs table with FK user_id references users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL and index idx_audit_logs_tenant_id
AuditController exposes GET /api/audit-logs?page=1&limit=20
GET /api/audit-logs requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/audit-logs filters by tenant_id and returns paginated { data, meta }
AuditController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
AuditModule is added to app.module.ts imports
